resources.string: When a notification arrives and more than one app is waiting, the LEDs glow once with a section in each app\'s colour, blending softly into the next. With only one app waiting, its rule\'s own look plays as usual. Nothing repeats, and unlocking the phone starts the count again.
Example colours. Your rules\' colours appear here once you have two notification rules.
Sections follow your rule order. Up to %1$d apps fit; the app that just notified always gets one.
%1$s and %2$s have similar colours, so their sections may be hard to tell apart.
